success.title: Admin Username is Secure
success.details: No user with the default 'admin' username was found. You can continue using strong, unique usernames. Never use easy to guess usernames like 'admin', 'administrator', 'root', 'user', '1', '2', '3', etc.
steps: Remove or rename any unused admin accounts

error.title: Default 'Admin' Username Found
error.details: A user with the default 'admin' username exists, which is a security risk. Never use easy to guess usernames like 'admin', 'administrator', 'root', 'user', '1', '2', '3', etc.
steps: Create a new administrator account with a unique username
Log in with the new administrator account
Delete or rename the 'admin' user account

learn_more.description: Using the default 'admin' username makes it easier for attackers to guess login credentials, as they only need to focus on cracking the password.
benefits: Reduced risk of brute force attacks
